Subject: Severe throughput drop and repeated 5xx — immediate remediation request

Logan,

We experienced a significant throughput collapse on Tuesday (10/3) between 03:00-09:30 UTC that caused backlogs in our inference pipeline. During that window our requests returned ~18% 5xx and median tail latency spiked from ~120ms to >1.2s. This materially impacted our patient triage workflow.

We escalated with your status page but need a concrete commercial remediation and SLA credit proposal from Redwood. Per our contract (Section 5.2) these kinds of outages trigger service credits and possible invoicing adjustments.

Please include a breakdown of the calculation, proposed credit amount, and any operational changes you will make to prevent recurrence. We would like an executive-level call this week — Rajan (CC) will coordinate timing.

Asha
Asha Mehta
Head of Product, Cycla Health
asha@cyclahealth.com

Subject: Initial commercial remediation proposal and credit calc (draft)

Asha — following up with the first-draft commercial remediation. We ran the numbers against the Cycla Q3 usage window and the contract SLOs. Key points:

Summary of exposure (draft):
- Impact window: 2026-10-03 03:00 — 2026-10-03 09:30 UTC
- Volume affected: ~3.2M tokens (tokenized inference units) across prioritized routes
- Observed 5xx rate: 18% during window; baseline 5xx <0.5%
- SLA deviation: tail-latency SLO exceeded by 1.0s median tail increase and throughput <50% expected capacity

Proposed commercial remedy (draft):
1) One-time invoice credit = 15% of Cycla’s Q3 hosted usage invoice (subject to legal review).
2) Additional service credit: 10% credit applied to the following two monthly invoices (applied as token credit).
3) Operational commitment: 90-day prioritized SLO monitoring with a named SRE contact and weekly status summaries.
4) Optional: two weeks of complimentary reserved capacity (1x large) to use during any scheduled bursts/maintenance windows.

Attached is the working spreadsheet with the calculator and assumptions (credit_calculation_q3.xlsx). This is a draft for discussion — happy to move faster if you want an exec sign-off route.

If Cycla asks for a larger immediate credit we’re prepared to escalate internally; please tell me the dollar range that would make you comfortable for an initial settlement.

Ben Carter
Commercial Lead, Enterprise Accounts | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

3) We’d like the exec call on Thursday 10/15 14:00 UTC. Please confirm who will attend from Redwood execs.

If you can provide the two credit scenarios and an editable amendment by EOD Monday I can route to finance/legal for provisional approval.

Rajan
